missing: An actual NAS shortlist: which current Synology/QNAP/UGREEN/Asustor models run Docker (Container Manager) well enough for Audiobookshelf transcoding plus Calibre-Web, with CPU/RAM, bay count, price, and whether ffmpeg/Calibre conversion works on each.
why: Every result is about the software (Audiobookshelf vs Calibre-Web, feature docs, deployment templates); not one names a NAS model, price, or spec. No major reviewer or authority touches the hardware question at all. A page comparing 6-10 Docker-capable NAS units with current prices, RAM/CPU adequacy for family-sized streaming, and a direct pick would be the only direct answer in the set.
